name: Communication and Organizational Tendencies (COT)
description: The Communication and Organizational Tendencies (COT) questionnaire measures a person's inclination to communicate with others and to organize them. It was designed for early career guidance.
instruction: Answer each question "yes" or "no". If you find it hard to choose, pick the answer that is closer to the truth.

1.text: Do you like getting to know people and making new acquaintances?

2.text: Do you enjoy volunteering or community work?

3.text: When a friend or colleague offends you, does the hurt stay with you for a long time?

4.text: Do you always find it hard to get your bearings in a critical situation?

5.text: Do you have many friends you keep in regular touch with?

6.text: Do you often manage to bring most of your colleagues around to your point of view?

7.text: Is it true that you would rather spend time with books or some other activity than with people?

8.text: If obstacles get in the way of your plans, do you give them up easily?

9.text: Do you easily make contact with people much older than you?

10.text: Do you like coming up with or organizing games and outings with friends?

11.text: Is it hard for you to join a new group of people?

12.text: Do you often put off until later things that should be done today?

13.text: Do you find it easy to make contact and talk with strangers?

14.text: Do you try to get your colleagues to act the way you think best?

15.text: Does it take you a long time to settle into a new team?

16.text: Is it true that you never get into conflicts with others over broken promises or neglected duties?

17.text: Do you take opportunities to meet and talk with someone new?

18.text: When something important needs to be decided, do you often take the initiative?

19.text: Do the people around you irritate you, so that you want to be alone?

20.text: Is it true that you usually find it hard to get your bearings in unfamiliar surroundings?

21.text: Do you like being around people all the time?

22.text: Do you get irritated when you can't finish something you started?

23.text: Do you find it hard to take the first step to get to know someone new?

24.text: Is it true that frequent socializing with others tires you?

25.text: Do you like taking part in group games?

26.text: Do you often take the initiative on matters that affect your colleagues?

27.text: Is it true that you feel unsure of yourself among strangers?

28.text: Is it true that you rarely try to prove you are right?

29.text: Do you think it's easy for you to liven up a group you barely know?

30.text: Do you take part in community activities at school or work?

31.text: Do you try to keep your circle of acquaintances small?

32.text: Is it true that you don't try to defend your opinion or decision if others don't accept it straight away?

33.text: Do you feel at ease when you join an unfamiliar group?

34.text: Are you happy to organize events for your colleagues?

35.text: Is it true that you don't feel confident and calm when you have to speak to a large group?

36.text: Are you often late for meetings or appointments?

37.text: Is it true that you have many friends?

38.text: Do you often find yourself the centre of attention among your colleagues?

39.text: Do you often feel embarrassed or awkward talking to people you barely know?

40.text: Is it true that you don't feel very confident in a large group of colleagues?
